values.note: 6 sites, all with tent pads, tables and fire rings; gravel campground roads and parking spurs.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/willow-creek-campground ('The campground has 6 sites all with tent pads, tables and fire rings and able to accommodate up to a 40' RV. Campground roads and parking spurs are gravel.'), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/willow-creek-campground ('Amenities include vault toilets'; 'Potable water is not available at this site.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'The campground is managed from Memorial Day through Labor Day, but is available all year to visitors. Access is dependent upon weather conditions.'

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/willow-creek-campground ('No fees are required for this site', '$0.00 Pack in/Pack out'; updated April 30, 2026), read 2026-10-22

note: Kootenai NF campground on Willow Creek, ~19 mi NE of Trout Creek on NFS Rd #54 (gravel). Pack in, pack out. (RV Life mislabeled the city as Charlo; the campground is near Trout Creek.) --Claude
summary: Confirmed 6 sites, 40-ft RV max, vault toilets, no potable water, free (2026). Added season (managed Memorial Day - Labor Day, open all year weather permitting). No access-road closure on the Kootenai alerts. Not stated: how sites are taken (not on recreation.gov; derived FCFS left). Note trimmed of restated values.
